title: Quenched Peppery Norwegian Silken Tofu Kjøttkaker Gratin
description: A show-stopping Norwegian dish featuring a creamy silken tofu and yuzu-cure filled Kjøttkaker topped with a golden-brown gratin.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup yuzu-cure
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian markets or online

instructions: Press the silken tofu in a colander for 15 minutes to remove excess liquid.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the grated carrot, cabbage, and zucchini, and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the yuzu-cure, season with salt and pepper to taste, and stir to combine.
Cut the pressed tofu into small cubes and add it to the pan, stirring to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with the grated cheddar cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
